, Reason for Mistake: After the Planner explicitly instructed cross-checking Mauro Scocco’s birth date with additional reputable sources (e.g., AllMusic, Discogs) to resolve the 1962 vs. 1963 discrepancy, WebSurfer did not follow through and instead kept reopening the same Wikipedia page.
